netbox/netbox_sut_buggy.py.derivation: five explicit intermediate-prefix source mechanisms + five externally observable sequence-local HTTP semantic classes + hidden server-side activation markers

faults.description: A valid first reassignment to another existing parent is acknowledged but discarded; a later GET exposes the stale relation.
Deleting a parent with at least two children succeeds but leaves dependents retrievable with the deleted reference.
Two distinct parent resources can be accepted with the same benchmark unique string value.

faults.class: second verified scalar update silently lost
faults.description: After one scalar update is verified, a second distinct update is acknowledged but discarded; the stale successful PATCH response is observable.
After valid parent-child history and parent deletion, a new child can reuse the deleted parent id and the successful create response exposes it.

semantic_classes.statement: A valid reassignment to a second existing parent is not persisted and is exposed by a later GET.
Deleting a parent with multiple children leaves at least one dependent retrievable.
Two distinct parents with the same unique required string are accepted.
A second distinct scalar update after verification is not persisted and returns stale success content.
A deleted parent id can be reused by a new child after valid parent-child history.
